title: Bible Reading Plan Quiz Schema
description: Schema for quiz questions and answers tied to Bible reading plan readings. Each quiz file corresponds to one reading plan and contains age-graded questions for each reading.

verseRef.description: Numeric verse reference in BBCCCVVV format (book 2 digits, chapter 3 digits, verse 3 digits). E.g., 40001001 = Matt 1:1, 1001001 = Gen 1:1.

data.description: Additional data depending on annotation type

sv.description: Start verse ref (BBCCCVVV) for scripture annotations

ev.description: End verse ref (BBCCCVVV) for scripture ranges

annotatedText.description: Text content with annotations for UI interpolation

ageGroup.description: Definition of an age group for quiz targeting

id.description: Machine-readable identifier (e.g., young_children, children, pre_teen, teen, adult)

question.description: A single quiz question with answer

answer.description: The answer text, including scripture references where appropriate

christFocused.description: True if the question centres on Jesus Christ, salvation, or God's redemptive purpose

references.description: Verse references from the reading that this question draws from

crossReferences.description: Cross-reference verses (from TSKE or doctrinal sources) that support the answer

readingQuizzes.description: Quizzes for a single reading, keyed by age group ID

sv.description: Start verse of the reading (matches plan)

ev.description: End verse of the reading (matches plan)

quizzes.description: Questions keyed by age group ID

^[a-z_]+$.description: Exactly 5 questions for this age group

quizDay.description: Quizzes for all readings on a single day

readings.description: Quiz sets for each reading on this day

planId.description: ID of the reading plan these quizzes correspond to

questionsPerReading.description: Number of questions per reading per age group

ageGroups.description: Age groups defined for this quiz set

days.description: Array of daily quiz sets, one per plan day
